svg.title: Nikhil Pawar: DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, SRE
svg.desc: MS in Computer Science at Northeastern University, previously a DevOps Engineer at HP Inc for 3.5 years. Open to a co-op from January to August 2027. Animated diagram of a GitOps pipeline: git push, Atlantis, Terraform, Proxmox, AWS, k3s, Argo CD, Grafana and a GPU worker node.
svg.text: MS CS @ Northeastern · ex-HP DevOps Engineer (3.5 yrs)
